Owner-approved book life and salvage scope.
Retirement preserves book basis; M-2C sale and tax separation.

invariants: Never infer federal depreciation/tax adjusted basis from book life
Never post disposal loss merely from retirement
Live OWNER-only finance writes, ADMIN view-only
No existing disposal duplication or closed-month mutation
No production data, money-out, Stripe, tax filing or messaging
sequence: Implement pure schedule and atomic journal writing
Add retirement evidence/transfer and append-only CPA notes
Build owner/admin fixed assets screen and audited configuration
Prove full real-DB concurrency and mobile acceptance
Exact-head CI, independent review and merge
acceptance: An additive, auditable BookAsset ledger identity records each enrolled owned rental appliance's immutable source acquisition cost, book placed-in-service/start month, useful life, salvage policy and version. Missing or conflicting acquisition evidence refuses enrollment and never fabricates book or tax basis.

Pure monthlySchedule computes safe integer-cent, straight-line management depreciation beginning the month after purchase/in-service under the approved ApplianceType lifetime or configured default (60 months) and salvage policy (default 0%); the last month absorbs rounding. Changed life/salvage never changes posted months, only the unposted remainder.

OWNER-approved bounded depreciation posting checks live role, book opening date, date cutoff, active appliance and period locks under Serializable transactions; each period creates a unique balanced DEPRECIATION:<YYYY-MM> entry using existing K-2 journal accounts, with replay/concurrent calls idempotent and closed periods handled by existing late-entry rules.

An appliance withdrawn from rentable service can be staged as RETIRED with dated SELL / DECIDE_LATER / SCRAP / STRIP / DISPOSE / DONATE_OTHER intent. Retirement stops additional depreciation and preserves exact remaining book carrying value; SELL or DECIDE_LATER records a single balanced transfer to separately mapped RETIRED_PENDING_DISPOSITION, never automatic full-value disposal loss.

Already posted legacy retirement/disposal journals, conflicting acquisition sources, a previous transfer or an already completed disposal fail closed with owner-visible review reason; retirement plans/versions are auditable, and the subsequent sale/disposal posting belongs to M-2C, never auto-implemented or recorded speculatively in K-6.

OWNER enters dated classification-specific federal/state tax-basis evidence in append-only per-asset history, with UNKNOWN/OWNER_SUPPLIED/CPA_CONFIRMED confidence, signed adjustments, allowed/allowable depreciation, section 179/bonus records and CPA/source reference. The screen strictly separates management book balances from IRS adjusted basis and never invents recapture, tax due, tax rate or filing.

OWNER can configure default book life and salvage with meaningful bounds and audit trail and can view/enroll/retire assets and add CPA evidence on a phone-ready Books fixed-assets page. ADMIN has strictly read-only books access, STAFF/CUSTOMER are denied, and no provider credentials, live charges, messages, destructive production writes or tax filing occur.

Real disposable PostgreSQL regression covers permissions, concurrent/double period posting, 1-cent rounding and DST Colorado cutoff, retirement carrying-value transfer, no premature write-off, immutable original journal/evidence, audit and CPA uncertainty; focused pure schedule tests, browser/axe and full exact-head CI/review are mandatory.

Update STATUS/roadmap/decision log, database and migration notes, owner guide, go-live CPA/retirement acceptance and the stored plan/scorecard honestly. Keep real CPA determination IN-56, trial asset reconciliation, external accountant acceptance and deployed release checks separate from source implementation.
